hypothesis: The minimal generic repair is to supervise the scene-global generic-query response field produced by the bounded AcceptedV2 typed-context residual; neither AcceptedV2 materialization nor the canonical capability carrier should be changed.

audited_integration_point.placement: after a complete scene's bounded typed-context semantic descriptors and official teacher observations are available, before the existing objective is backpropagated
audited_integration_point.required_future_batch_change: evaluate one complete sealed scene in canonical region-row order; chunk only query and negative-pair axes

loss_contract.scope: one complete scene in canonical region-row order
loss_contract.teacher_response: temperature-0.05 log-mean-exp of official per-view descriptor cosine responses

components.centered_response_profile: mean over nonconstant generic queries of one minus cosine between student and teacher scene-response vectors after centering over regions
components.pairwise_ordering: SmoothL1 of student and teacher normalized response gaps on sealed hard-negative pairs; query units with absolute teacher gap below 0.05 of that query's scene span are excluded
components.hard_negative_triplet: descriptor triplet against official teacher consensus descriptors with margin min(0.1, 0.5*(1-teacher_pair_cosine))

loss_contract.component_combination: unweighted arithmetic mean of the three finite component means
loss_contract.zero_weight_contract: return the caller's existing base loss object directly without evaluating or adding an auxiliary zero
loss_contract.zero_init_contract: retain the existing zero-final-projection typed-context residual so epoch-zero predictions remain bitwise immutable AcceptedV2 e0

source_access.text_queries_opened_field_semantics: legacy field meaning benchmark text queries only

stopping_rule: Implement and unit-test only. Do not modify the frozen trainer, launch training, or open a benchmark in this task.
